pages.title: A Rendezvous , One Year Later
pages.paragraph:
A full cycle of seasons has passed since I last donned Marin’s JK uniform.
A year ago, it was about the rush of restoration; today, it is about the quietude of introspection. Standing before the lens again, I feel the shift—a transition from youthful enthusiasm to a calm, deep-seated desire to express something of my own. It is a testament to how time alters not just our tools, but the resilience of the artist’s soul.
There is a touch of sorcery in these images. The ethereal flight you see was born not of suspension rigs, but of a fleeting posture upon a stool, cleansed later by the digital brush of AI. Finding the clever path from "impossible" to "possible" is where the secret delight of artistry resides.
I chose a gentle Rembrandt lighting this time, hoping to trace the character’s mood rather than simply brightening the frame. Each ray of light serves as a voyage into the psyche.
Looking toward 2026, I plan to honor each shoot with a physical & electric photobook—a tangible memory for every moment prepared with care. I hope that every time the shutter falls, it bridges the gap between reality and the love within my heart.
